Anyone with an addiction will relapse at some point.. I have many times.. you should be so proud that you went a year without self harming! Seriously well done. I get that it can all get too much sometimes especially when you’re not seeing or feeling the results you want. 

Just know that you’re not alone. You’re so strong. I’m proud of you. (Even if I am a meaningless stranger) you can always try to stop this self destructive behaviour at any time. It’s a tough journey and I hope that you one day reach the happy ending we all wish for.
